origin.description: Rank and condition number from the positive singular values.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Singular values must exceed tol to count toward the rank.

origin.details: Rank is the number of singular values above tol. A deficient matrix treats the smallest retained value as zero before the condition ratio, so the condition is infinite when the largest value is positive. An all-zero matrix has condition NaN.
origin.value: A dict with rank, condition, and tol.
